$comment: The CyVault Entra External ID setup that each azd environment gets. Set-EntraApps.ps1 applies it before `azd provision`: each environment gets its own app registrations, consent grants and user flow, in the tenant its azd environment names (ENTRA_TENANT_ID). The tenant itself comes from infra/tenant/, and its Google identity provider from Set-GoogleProvider.ps1.
$tenantComment: The production tenant: the default for environments that don't set ENTRA_TENANT_ID, ENTRA_INSTANCE and ENTRA_GOOGLE_PROVIDER_ID.
